prose: Chris Bores, AKA the Ghost Doctor, joins InnerVerse to discuss his research on the psychology of paranormal entities. Topics include the categories of spirit motivations, a few of his most mind blowing ghost interviews, the structure of the afterlife, remedying sleep paralysis, the stages of haunting phenomenon, digging out from the pit of psychic clutter and negative attachments, and much more.
ext: Chris gives his take on dark spiritual influences behind world power establishments and agendas, the pandemic of paranormal ignorance, stages of metempsychosis, spiritual waystations like churches and hospitals, reasons to "go into the light" at your time, the afterlife benefits of meditation while living, and the relationship between spirits and electromagnetism.
